hec.rss.model

Class SystemOpRuleRef

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.util.Observable
      • hec.lang.NamedType
        • hec.rss.model.SystemOpRuleRef
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AsciiSerializable, FieldAccessor, java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Cloneable, java.lang.Comparable, java.util.Observer, rma.lang.Modifiable

    public class SystemOpRuleRef
extends NamedType
implements AsciiSerializable, java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Cloneable
    SystemOpRuleRef - This class is a wrapper class that contains a reference to a System Operation Rule. Rules are created independant of the Storage Zone, so the Storage Zones contain a set of SystemOpRuleRef's which reference rules.

      • clone

        public java.lang.Object clone()
                       throws java.lang.CloneNotSupportedException
